best_for: Small teams that already plan work in ClickUp and want it in its own window on the desktop, and who can live inside the Free plan's limits until they outgrow them.

points.title: Free has a real ceiling
points.text: Free Forever gives unlimited tasks and members but only 60 MB of file storage, 5 Spaces, 3 whiteboards, 1 form and 100 automation actions a month.

points.title: Paid plans per user
points.text: Core is USD 9 per user per month billed yearly, Business USD 17 and Max USD 100; Enterprise is quoted by sales. The page does not list monthly-billing prices for paid plans. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: AI comes in credits
points.text: Paid plans include pooled AI credits each month, from 1,000 per user on Core to 10,000 on Max. More cost USD 10 per 10,000 credits.

points.title: What Free already includes
points.text: Tasks, Docs, Kanban boards, calendar view, sprints, time tracking, SyncUps video calls and two-factor sign-in are all on the free plan. Custom fields, Gantt charts and unlimited storage start at Core.

points.title: Windows installs either way
points.text: Windows has a per-user installer and an MSI for the whole machine, both x64. The Windows listing keeps 24 versions; macOS lists only the current release, for Intel and Apple silicon on macOS 13 or later.

points.title: Linux is not listed here
points.text: ClickUp's download page does offer a Linux build, along with apps for iPhone, Android and Apple Watch, but this site tracks only the Windows and Mac apps.
